[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1674053212573{background-color: #ffffff !important;}”][vc_column width=”3/4″][vc_column_text]

The Ecumenical Institute is the forge of the Principality of Sabourg for advanced theological research and religious intercommunication of an international nature.
The impetus behind its creation came from the reconstitution of the Principality of Sabourg, on 28 December 2019 by the establishment of the Monastic Order of Seborga, a religious congregation incardinated in the Monegasque cult organisation PNCC, in order to bring into dialogue all the existing realities within modern Christianity, whether of Catholic or Orthodox extraction, but also Protestant, Anglican and any other ideological nature.
The Institute also assumes the objective of ecumenical dialogue between all Christians with the Jewish religion, Muslims, both Shiite and Sunni, and any other existing reality of worship on the planet.
